title: Reframe as Little Mester MCP with modular ticketing
objective: Reframe the ticketing engine as a generic MCP server ('Little Mester MCP') with a ticketing module as the first implementation. Support multiple routing modes (same-repo: point at workspace/docs/tickets/, any-directory: point at any path, separate-repo: git-synced separate repo). MCP tools named mester_tickets_create, mester_tickets_search, mester_tickets_board, etc. — generic enough that mester_files_search or mester_notes could live alongside.
